title: Lavender Mangrove Swamp
description: transforms the entire mangrove biome into a purple‑themed variant, giving it a fresh, mystical, and visually unique identity. Mangrove wood, leaves, roots, mud, and related textures are recolored or redesigned to match a lavendar
body:
### Lavender Mangrove Swamp

Features
Recolored mangrove logs, planks, doors, trapdoors, boats, roots, and leaves

Soft purple shading that blends naturally

Works on Minecraft 1.21.11

Lightweight and performance‑friendly

Compatibility
Works with Fabric, Forge, NeoForge, and Vanilla

Shader‑friendly

Multiplayer‑safe

Install
Download the .zip

Place it in resourcepacks

Enable it in Minecraft

Links
YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@plastic-mc_yt_vid

Website: https://powercollective.fun/

Support: https://buymeacoffee.com/plasticplaye7

About
A clean lavender recolor for players who want a magical, fantasy‑style mangrove biome without breaking the vanilla look.
